title: Real Estate Marketing Budget: How to Calculate It From Cost per Lead, Visit and Booking
seoTitle: Real Estate Marketing Budget: How to Calculate It
excerpt: How to set a real estate marketing budget from your own numbers: cost per lead, per site visit and per booking, channel split, test budget and costly mistakes.

inlineImages.caption: Compare channels on cost per site visit, not cost per lead.

faqs.question: How much should a builder spend on real estate marketing?
faqs.answer: Work backwards: bookings needed × your cost per booking, plus creative, tools and fees, then check it against the margin per unit. We haven't found a reliable published percentage-of-revenue benchmark for Indian projects, so your own numbers are the best guide.

faqs.question: How do you calculate cost per lead in real estate?
faqs.answer: Divide ad spend by the number of leads. For example, ₹1,00,000 spent for 250 leads is a cost per lead of ₹400. Also calculate cost per qualified lead, per site visit and per booking, because cheap leads are often not buyers.

faqs.question: What is a reasonable cost per lead for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: There is no single honest figure: it depends on city, price segment, platform, ad, landing page, form type and season. Set your own baseline in the first month and improve against it. Judge channels on cost per site visit and per booking.

faqs.question: What is customer acquisition cost in real estate?
faqs.answer: The total marketing spend divided by the number of bookings it produced: what it costs to sell one unit. Compare it with your margin per unit to see whether a channel is worth scaling.

faqs.question: How should a real estate marketing budget be split?
faqs.answer: By job: Google search to capture existing demand, Meta ads to create demand, hoardings and print for local launch awareness, channel partners and portals, and lasting assets like the landing page and video. Then move money monthly towards the lowest cost per visit.

faqs.question: What is the minimum ad budget for a real estate project?
faqs.answer: We recommend at least ₹15,000 a month per project on ads as a starting point, more for a launch or a competitive market. Run it for four to six weeks and set the full budget from the results.

faqs.question: What are the biggest real estate marketing budget mistakes?
faqs.answer: Judging channels by cost per lead, slow follow-up, no tracking, sending ads to a homepage, spreading money over too many channels, and spending everything at launch with nothing left for retargeting.

faqs.question: What should a monthly marketing report for a builder show?
faqs.answer: One row per channel with spend, leads, qualified leads, site visits, bookings, cost per visit and cost per booking, plus a one-line decision on where money moves next month.
